نغتاب (form VIII)

# نُغْتَابُ (nuḡtābu) /nuɣ.taː.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَابَ (iḡtāba)
# نَغْتَابَ (naḡtāba) /naɣ.taː.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَابَ (iḡtāba)
# نُغْتَابَ (nuḡtāba) /nuɣ.taː.ba/: first-person plural non-past
